concept.title: Sync Detail
concept.shortdesc: The Sync Detail page displays the full configuration of a single sync and gives you controls to run, edit, or delete it.

conbody.p: To open the Sync Detail page, click a sync name from the Dashboard or the Syncs list. The page is divided into a configuration summary at the top and a run history table at the bottom.

section.title: Configuration summary
section.p: The configuration summary shows the values set when the sync was created or last edited, including the sync name, source adapter, target connector, Deployment ID, assigned credential, and schedule. If no automatic schedule is configured, the schedule displays as Manual sync only.

section.title: Action buttons
section.p: Four action buttons appear near the top of the page:

dlentry.dd: Triggers an incremental sync run. The service fetches only content that has changed since the last successful run. Use this for routine on-demand publishing.

Triggers a full resync that walks the entire Heretto Deploy structure and processes every article regardless of modification date. Use this when you suspect content is out of sync or after a long gap in sync activity.
Opens the sync configuration form so you can change the sync name, schedule, field mapping, or other settings.
Permanently deletes the sync configuration and removes its automatic schedule. This action cannot be undone.

section.title: Run history
section.p: The run history table at the bottom of the page lists recent runs for this sync. Each row shows the run status, the time the run started and completed, and the number of articles changed. Click View all to open the full Run History page filtered to this sync.
